source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: Cologix is a network-neutral interconnection and edge data center operator headquartered in Denver, Colorado, operational since December 2010, describing itself as North America's leading network-neutral interconnection and hyperscale edge data center company, with more than 45 facilities across 13 North American markets serving roughly 2,000 customers with access to more than 725 networks and more than 350 cloud service providers, per the operator's own materials. This facility, ASH2, is part of Cologix's Ashburn, Virginia campus in Loudoun County's Data Center Alley, with this registry's own records showing two closely associated Beaumeade Circle addresses (21673 and 21745) for the campus; 21745 Beaumeade Circle is also the address recorded elsewhere in this registry for the separate ASH1 building, so ASH2 and ASH1 are treated as sibling buildings on one shared Cologix Ashburn campus rather than fully independent, unrelated addresses. The operator's own materials associate 51 MW of IT capacity with this record, though a facility-specific breakdown separating ASH1 from ASH2 was not located in sourcing reachable this session. Cologix grew through a series of acquisitions beginning in 2010, including Navisite, The Minnesota Gateway, Canix, MetroOptic in 2019, vXchnge in 2020-2021 (which brought the company's Silicon Valley SV1 facility into the portfolio), and Cyxtera in 2023, the last of which connects to the separate Cyxtera operator record tracked elsewhere in this registry. No individual square footage or year-opened figure specific to ASH2 was located in sourcing reachable this session. The Beaumeade Circle corridor sits within the broader Loudoun County "Data Center Alley" cluster tracked extensively elsewhere in this registry (NTT, Digital Realty, Aligned, H5, and others), reflecting Cologix's strategy of interconnection-focused edge facilities positioned inside the world's densest data center market rather than standalone campuses in secondary metros.

reading.body:
Cologix ASH2 in Ashburn, Virginia is a 51 MW IT capacity data center across two addresses in a market that has published figures for only 23 of its 326 mapped facilities. This campus ranks ninth among Virginia's published capacity and represents 3.7 percent of the state's disclosed 1,375 MW total. The operator is network-neutral, meaning the campus qualifies to host multiple tenants across different service providers rather than serving a single customer.

At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 51 MW of IT load translates to roughly 1,275 racks. At 6 kW per GPU in large-scale training clusters, this would support approximately 8,500 high-end accelerators. Whether ASH2 operates at these densities is not published. The facility was not confirmed to house AI workloads specifically; network-neutral colocation serves hyperscale, cloud, and enterprise tenants across use cases.

The campus sits in Northern Virginia's Ashburn cluster, a zone of extreme datacenter density fed by multiple fiber routes but not yet known to this site as constrained by local power. Published power capacity alone does not indicate whether ASH2 has access to sufficient grid allocation to run at nameplate, or whether expansion is grid-limited in practice. Neither the operator's current utilization nor specific power interconnection agreements are published.
